reviews.text:
If I could give zero stars, I would. My husband and I hired Robert Murtaugh of Condition K-9 for 8 in-home dog training sessions, paying $1,195 upfront.
Things started fine-ish, but by the 3rd visit, the problems began. Robert missed a scheduled session without calling or texting. When I finally reached him, he rescheduled for the next day and we explicitly confirmed he would be at our next regular session the following week. However, he no-showed again, no call or text. I called and left a voicemail. When he finally called back, he blamed the holiday weekend followed by other excuses, but he had known about the holiday and never communicated the need to cancel. He even used the excuse that he had been to too many Pink Floyd concerts and forgot.
Due to the lack of professionalism, we decided to end the training. We had received 4 visits (including the evaluation which turned into an evaluation/session), meaning we were owed a refund of $597.50. Instead, Robert insisted we switch to a different plan we never asked for, claiming our refund would only be $400. He constantly delayed us. He also claimed that he did not understand why we were upset with him and kept on with his excuses. When I refused to let it go regarding the refund, he ended with someone named "Mo" would call to handle it between 10:00 and 5:00 the next day and that he's "done talking about this". I had to text Robert the next day that I had not been contacted in that time frame. Mo then reached out. We agreed to the refund of $400.00 to get it over with and received it via Venmo. Getting our money back proved to be a nightmare, one that we are glad to be over.
Based on what my husband and I experienced, this is our personal opinion:  Save your time and money.  Look elsewhere for a dependable dog trainer.

We were looking for someone to help us train our new Puppy a bernedoodle.  After research And Reading reviews decided to hire Robert.  He did a great job over the first four weeks   Our puppy has come a long ways and we are very pleased with his service  I would recommend Robert

I highly recommend Rob for dog training and general pet advice. He has been incredibly patient, not only with my dog, but with me as well throughout the training process. One of the biggest things I’ve learned is that training is just as much about the owner learning how to properly communicate and give direction as it is about the dog learning commands.
Although I already had a strong bond with my dog, this experience has strengthened that bond even more. Rob’s approach is calm, engaging, easy to understand, and he truly makes the process enjoyable. He gives practical techniques and exercises to continue working on at home, which has made a huge difference in our progress.
I’ve also noticed he works well with all different types of dogs and personalities, so it’s clear he’s very experienced and knowledgeable with various breeds and temperaments. I’m extremely happy with the results and grateful for the positive experience. I would definitely bring my dog back for more training. Recommended 100 %.

Robert is the absolute best! His calm demeanor and understanding of dog behavior has been a huge help for JuneBug. I adopted Junie from Freedom Brothers rescue less than a year ago. She is so perfect until she has to meet new people. Then her over-excitement causes her to act dominantly and can progress to unwanted behaviors. Robert’s training and guidance have been instrumental in helping her become the best doggo she can be. He not only knows what to do to correct the behavior but he understands her why. Combining both of these things and formulating a plan and targeted training exercises has already been such a huge help. I highly recommend Robert and would trust him to work with any and all dogs and dog parents.

Amazing experience with Robert! He is calm, patient, and amazing with both our wild lab puppy and timid senior rescue. We have seen such a big improvement in our dog’s behavior. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a caring and effective trainer!
So great with my puppy!

Robert has been absolutely amazing with our family and our rescue dog, Mo. Watching him work so calmly and confidently with our pup was incredibly reassuring and made us feel completely confident continuing training and moving into boarding. Condition K-9 has exceeded our expectations; you won’t be disappointed!

Robert has helped me so much with my dog Charlie. She is one stubborn girl and has been very hard for me to train. He has been very patient in breaking some pretty bad habits. He is very knowledge about canine behavior and I believe that has been a huge help. On top of that Charlie is normally apprehensive about new people, but she has loved him from the beginning. I look forward to continuing our training sessions.
Robert did a great job on my out of control 3 year old chocolate lab. The proof is in the video on facebook. Thanks Robert.

Found Robert right in time when our pups were in need of a different level of training, and couldn't be more happy! Much better than constantly trying to repeat one word commands with treats all day when I'm trying to navigate a busy household with the kids running around and trying to train puppies.
A master of dog behavior. He was quickly able to diagnose what was going on with our dog and gave us an achievable plan of action.

Working with Robert has been life changing for us. His methods slanted with me because the are  based on learning theory and truly work. I have worked with another trainer in the past, but Robert taught me what I need to do differently. Tucson can be stubborn (litter wide trait), but constant training with him has helped him become one fantastic dog. He recently started agility class with Robert,  and is working on his confidence with these skills.
Amazing job with my dog. Robert was very knowledgeable and gentle with my Toon. He is a half lab half shepherd and Robert knew exactly how to handle him with love and care.

My 10-year old Pitbull Max has been to about 5 other trainers in the valley for his dog aggression (which started after being attacked by 2 dogs) before I called Robert.

Robert is the first trainer that we have been to where Max is not stressed out being with him. He is very professional, calm, and treats both myself and Max with respect. I was not given an hour by hour military style schedule to keep my dog on; he is not "required to be in a crate 20 hours a day" like other trainers have told me to do. I do not have to shock my dog until he is compliant, or use any other negative reinforcement gadgets. My dog can be a dog and he is making great strides.

Max is starting to settle a lot more with dogs in sightline. This is a huge step forward when other trainers have told me to put him down or give him up. Couldn't be more pleased with the progress so far and it's only been about 2 weeks of work.

Simply stated - Robert is phenomenal! His presence from the moment he walked through our front door had our pack of dogs mesmerized. We were in total shock. Normally they would have been barking, jumping and carrying on. He spoke softly and with a friendly tone. Suddenly, they were all super calm and they all wanted to be his best friend. You have to understand that our dogs don't do that with anyone. They are almost all COVID dogs so they aren't as well socialized as we'd like.

We signed up for a training package and got started the following week. We have been so impressed with Robert's knowledge of the different dog breeds and that he trains them based on their individual breed traits. That's a feat with our pack. We have an Alaskan Malamute, a Border Collie, a Mastiff mix, a Great Pyrenees mix, and two supermutts (one mostly Pitbull and the other mostly Chow).

We have learned so much from Robert and the simple tricks he's taught us have really made our home a more peaceful place. We understand that we still have a good deal of work ahead of us because we have a motley crew of rescue pups who all have different ancestry and natural instincts, but Robert has saved our sanity.

I can't recommend Robert enough. If you want a trainer who really understands your dog, and you're willing to listen to his advice and suggestions, call Robert.

Robert is nothing short of a dog whisperer! From the very first session, it's clear how incredibly knowledgeable he is about a wide range of dog breeds and behaviors. His in-home training sessions are a total game changer. He works directly in your dog’s real environment, which makes a huge difference in results.

What really sets Robert apart is his ability to handle multiple dogs in the same household with ease. He understands pack dynamics, tailors his approach to each dog’s personality, and creates harmony in a way that feels almost magical. The progress seen was fast, effective, and long-lasting.

If you’re looking for a trainer who truly understands dogs and delivers amazing results, Robert is the one. Highly recommend!

Had my service animal here for a weekend when I had to go somewhere that wasn't conducive for her to be at. It was a great experience and Robert worked well with my schedule of when I needed to leave town. Had no problems with me being able to pick my service animal up on a Sunday. Really great experience. Would trust Robert with my dog anytime!

Rob is great with dogs, from the first session to 6th  is what I’m at now, we’re seeing a huge improvement with our 6 year old rescue. He is not aggressive but on a leash around other dogs he can get reactive and we have been working on that with rob and we see huge changes in his behavior. Rob cares about your animal and you can tell he genuinely cares for dogs and shows them the love you do. Any kind of training you need, I feel this is the guy you would want, he knows a lot from diet for your dog, to a bunch of ways to help with whatever is going on. Highly recommend!! He is on time to the sessions which is great and communicates with you well, if you need to cancel or anything like that. Highly recommend Rob!!
Robert is extremely professional and very skilled in his craft of training dogs, this place is the way to go if you are looking for courteous, professional, and well done dog training

Robert has been immensely helpful in giving us the tools to keep our two dogs, Cash & Lilly, safe and well mannered.   We came to Robert after our dogs got in to a fight in our home, and have been quite dog selective with unknown dogs in the past.   He was able to give us the skills and knowledge to confidently lead our dogs in a positive way and restored peace in our home.   He has extensive background in working with reactive dogs, rescues, etc.  We could not recommend him enough!

Robert at Condition K9 has an incredible gift for connecting with dogs. From our very first session, we noticed a huge improvement with Sasha, our energetic 1-year-old white Siberian Husky. She has a lively, diva-like personality that’s very different from our calm 9-year-old Rottweiler, who’s more like a giant teddy bear that shadows me with perfect behavior.

Since Sasha is really our 11-year-old son Gavin’s dog, it was important that he learn how to work with her. Robert not only trained Sasha, but also showed Gavin how to build a bond with her through mostly non-verbal commands. Now the two of them enjoy working together and even practicing fun agility exercises.

The facility itself is spacious, clean, and perfect for training. I highly recommend Robert and Condition K9 to anyone looking for effective, professional, and positive training.

Brian is an excellent trainer. It was obvious from the first time we introduced our puppy to him that he had a way with animals. He understands the importance of language between dog and owner and how the training is as much about the owner as the dog. His facility has interactive equipment used for basic training as well as agility and performance skills. He has been very flexible with us and accommodating to our busy schedules. If you want to learn how to communicate with your dog, this is the best place for you.
Robert has been amazing with my dog, Remi. You can tell he truly cares about the dogs and is passionate about what he does. I can’t recommend him highly enough!

Robert at Condition K-9 is Fantastic! He goes above and beyond to take care of his pet guests. We completely trust him with our Big Guy Trappy. Incredible place, great location, super clean facility and very trustworthy. We don’t know what we would do without Condition K-9! Also, our dog just loved Robert immediately . We highly recommend Condition K-9 for all of their services!

I can’t say enough good things about this rescue. It’s not just a place where dogs are given a second chance — it’s a place filled with heart, compassion, and people who genuinely live to make a difference. The team behind this rescue are some of the most selfless, caring, and dedicated individuals I’ve ever met. You can see it in the way they treat every animal that comes through their doors — not just as a case or a number, but as a life that matters.

They take in dogs that others might overlook — the scared, the broken, the ones with special needs — and they work tirelessly to rehabilitate, heal, and rehome them with love. Every dog is treated like family, and it shows. The level of care, transparency, and follow-through is rare in the world of rescue. You can tell this is a labor of love, not profit.

If you’re looking to adopt, foster, or just support a rescue that truly does things right — this is the one. They’re not just saving dogs — they’re restoring trust, healing hearts, and creating hope.

Robert has a gift for connecting with any and every dog. Rather than apply one training theory to all, he will focus on understanding your dog and figuring out the best approach to motivate a change in behavior without pressure or punishment. He will easily become a trusted leader to your pet. I’ve never seen someone read animals the way Robert does, and with such patience and finesse. We have a boxer who failed multiple trainings, consequently we were contemplating giving our dog away for frustration and liability reasons, but Robert has given us hope! Thank you doesn’t say enough. Highly recommend!

I highly recommend Robert for dog training services, he makes sure to educate you every step of the way.. He is very patient with the customer and the process, He’s very helpful with any questions and concerns also very informative. Robert helped me with training 4 of my dogs. They’ve learned important commands and manners.. I recommend him to anyone that wants a better relationship with your pet.
I am so pleased with Robert. His training technique is wonderful, and my dog has made vast improvement. I would highly recommend Condition K9

Robert has done a great job with our Great Dane. With his size it was important for us to have a dog that was trained well enough to take in public with no worries. We are so happy with Robert we have left our dog with him a few different times while we have travelled and every time we return the dog is much calmer and better behaved. I recommend Robert with a 10/10 rating

This place is great, I have taken my dog here twice and this is the only place I would ever take her. Rob does a great job working with her, I know she is in good hands with him. Rob sends me video updates of how she’s doing and the training they are working on. If you are looking for a kennel or training I highly recommend them.

Robert is the real deal and has been tremendously helpful training my foster pup Venus! She’s very smart and very stubborn (not always the easiest combo) but even in the few sessions we have had, the direction from him has been so helpful! Dogs are sensitive to energy and Venus really seems to respond to him which is so cool to see. I’m also seeing immediate positive changes with her behavior on walks and have been watching her confidence grow daily which is so important for her. Training with him is setting her up for success in her future home and I can’t wait to see her progress continue. I would highly recommend him to anybody looking to deepen their understanding of their dogs psychology, and behavior.

Our experience with Rob was incredible. We were scared to travel and felt stuck because we had no one we could trust to watch our dogs. After a few sessions training with rob their behavior on the leash improved and he taught us how to train. They were able to stay at his facility when we had to travel and always came back so happy and well taken care of. On our wedding day Rob was so helpful and watched them  and brought them bye for a pictures and life long memories. We recommend Rob and his team 10/10!!!!

Working with Rob has been a transformative experience for both me and my dog. From the beginning, it was clear that Rob has a deep passion for animals and a natural connection with them. My dog had trouble focusing, was easily spooked, and walking him on a leash was a daily challenge. These issues were creating a lot of stress and concern for my other dog's safety.

Rob took the time not only to work with my dog, but also to teach me how to better understand and support him. His commitment and desire to help are very clear and his calm, knowledgeable approach gave me practical tools and techniques that have made a huge difference. I learned how to build a stronger connection so my dog feels more comfortable and secure, which has helped reduce his anxiety and reactivity. By focusing on building the relationship, trust, and expectations (rather than fear based training), I am so happy my dog didn't lose his goofy personality we just know how to better communicate with each other!

I’m so grateful for Rob’s guidance and expertise and will continue to lean on him as new challenges arise or with future dogs I have.

Robert is knowledgeable, patient, and understanding. Everything you need and want in a dog trainer. He has already helped my reactive dog more in 2 sessions than any other trainer I’ve worked with. Would recommend to anyone!

Robert is so good with our boys. He  is patient, perceptive, and caring. You can tell he really loves and understands dogs too. After just two in home sessions and one group session, we’re already seeing positive changes. Thank you Robert!

Robert  does a great job with the dogs.  I adopted two dogs from Freedom Brothers Recovery and Rescue that are just full of love love love! You'll find your next wiggly giggly butt Supa buddy here for sure! Or buddies, like I did! Call before going out for training times and check out the website and Facebook page for adoptable dogs.

We had such a wonderful experience! Robert did a great job explaining our role in our dogs training, providing us tips on how to continue working with him, and even wrote notes for us to keep. We look forward to continuing training sessions with him.
Outstanding trainer. Skilled in obedience and behavioral issues. I am very impressed with the education and kindness. You cannot go wrong.

I have never seen a more dedicated dog training and rescue group. I have worked in the pet industry for 20 years and have had the opportunity to get to know a lot of rescue groups and trainers. Every dog that goes home with their new forever family has been set up with the best chance possible for success as a result of the excellent and rigorous training they receive here. These are lucky dogs and lucky adopters. I highly recommend adopting from them or visiting for classes and training. This is a great organization! Thankful for all I've learned watching Rob train the dogs. Thanks! Linda M California, Bay Area.

I found this outstanding dog enrichment, training and boarding center when I was looking for my dog to try an agility course and have been continuously impressed by all the services Condition K9 offers.
Robert has guided me to improve my relationship with my dog by helping me understand better ways of working with my dog’s behaviors and improving the acclimation from puppy to adult. Robert is patient and takes the time to understand and offer solutions that fits our situation best.
Aside from all of the amazing services and tools K9 Condition offers - they run a wonderful nonprofit organization that rehomes dogs. It takes very special people to pour so much needed value into the community and this world. I would highly recommend Condition K9 to anyone who wants to learn new skills that benefit the overall experience of having a well behaved happy dog no matter what stage in life, they offer so many unique options. Thank you Condition K9 for all that you do!!!

Highly recommend. Robert is an amazing person. He is honest trustworthy and communicates very well, not only with people but with dogs as well. If you’re looking for a dog trainer, this is the company.

I needed a dog trainer who could do in-home training.  Robert does just that.  Robert has been working with me and my two  dogs for the last 6 weeks. I am blown away by how much we have accomplished in that time.  Both my dogs are now walking with leases. They have learned how to sit, stay, come and down. They can get in and out of my car. I am so pleased with the results that  I hired Robert for another 6 weeks of training for the me  and my
dogs. I highly recommend Robert with Condition K-9

Robert works wonders and never gives up on a dog!! I have 3 year old Border Collie mix. I was having a lot of trouble with him and didn’t know what to do! I was about to give up and was introduced to Robert. Within about a month things had …

Robert watches my dog when I go out of town and she absolutely loves it there and loves him. It’s a big playground for her and he works with her on some maintenance training while she’s there. I believe in his cause and I know he does great work.

Robert has been an incredibly caring, compassionate and brilliant trainer to my rescue dog.
He has never made us feel rushed - he takes his time learning about your dog and …

We left our dogs in Robert’s good hands when we went on vacation for almost two weeks.  He sent us video updates of the doggies being trained while we were away, and really made us feel comfortable that they were being well cared for.   He …

I was really losing hope with my dog constantly marking and chewing all my belongings.  I thought that i was going to have to find another home for her.  Running out of options i asked a friend and she suggested Robert, and I am amazed at …
Robert does a great job!   Very knowledgeable and patient.. would highly recommend
We liked what we saw in the reviews so after researching other training programs decided to get a pup package - 4 at home private and 4 at facility group lessons. …
